verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes a fully documented, standards-based JMAP API with token/OAuth auth and HTTP-only workflows (single-roundtrip method calls, well-known discovery), and a runtime probe confirms the JMAP endpoint and autodiscovery are live and keyless-discoverable, making scripted/CI automation feasible. API tokens and app-password SMTP access are also documented/used by users for scripted sending (community reports using SMTP app passwords for automated mail). missing for 10: no official CLI tool, no llms.txt/OpenAPI spec found (probes 404), and no first-party CI/automation examples or SDKs beyond raw JMAP/OAuth docs.
